device.description: 16-bit ultra-low-power unbuffered voltage-output DAC with SPI interface
device.note: dac8830.pdf (SLAS449D) p.1 description, p.4 power supply 2.7-5.5 V and digital inputs, p.5 pin configuration and terminal functions, p.6 Figure 1 timing, p.7 timing characteristics, p.15-16 power-on reset and serial interface

commands.name: Load input register
commands.note: p.16: CS low, SDI latched on SCLK rising MSB first; at CS rising the last 16 bits go to the input register (fewer than 16 bits corrupt the word); the DAC latch follows at once (p.16)

pages: p.1 (reset to zero code), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 (pinout), p.6 (Figure 1: SCLK low at CS falling, SDI sampled on rising edges), p.7 (timing), p.15-16 (power-on reset, serial interface); dac8830-ep.pdf p.9 (EP part timing)
notModeled: analog: unbuffered voltage output, reference input
a frame of fewer than 16 bits corrupts the word (bits remain from the previous word); the model ignores frames shorter than 16 bits
the serial shift register is undefined at power-up
variants: dac8830.pdf covers the DAC8830 (SO-8, no LDAC) and DAC8831 (SO-14/QFN-14 with LDAC, bipolar resistors); DAC8830MCDEP (dac8830-ep.pdf, -55 to 125 C) has the same pinout and interface
